title: The Gandhian Era: Mass Struggles to Independence

questions.question: Gandhi returned to India from South Africa in January 1915. His first Indian satyagraha, at Champaran in 1917, was against:
options: The tinkathia indigo system of European planters
questions.rationale: At Champaran (1917), with Rajendra Prasad assisting, Gandhi's inquiry ended the tinkathia rule forcing tenants to grow indigo on three-twentieths of their land.

questions.question: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre took place on:
questions.rationale: On Baisakhi day, 13 April 1919, General Dyer fired on an unarmed crowd in Amritsar; the Hunter Commission's mild censure destroyed Indian faith in British justice.

questions.question: Gandhi withdrew the Non-Cooperation movement after:
options: The Chauri Chaura incident of 5 February 1922
The failure of the Second Round Table Conference
questions.rationale: A crowd burnt a police station with policemen at Chauri Chaura (Gorakhpur) on 5 February 1922; Gandhi called off the movement at Bardoli rather than let violence define it.

questions.question: The Nehru Report of 1928 and Jinnah's Fourteen Points of 1929 respectively represented:
options: Congress's constitutional draft and the League's counter-demands
questions.rationale: Motilal Nehru's committee drafted a dominion-status constitution; Jinnah's Fourteen Points marked the League's rejection and parting of ways.

questions.question: The Purna Swaraj resolution was passed at the Lahore session of Congress in December 1929 under whose presidency?
questions.rationale: The Lahore session under Jawaharlal Nehru voted complete independence, observed as Independence Day on 26 January 1930.

questions.question: The Dandi March of 1930 covered roughly:
questions.rationale: From 12 March to 6 April 1930, Gandhi walked about 240 miles with 78 followers to break the salt law at Dandi for eight annas of tax.

questions.question: The Poona Pact of September 1932 between Gandhi and Ambedkar:
options: Granted separate electorates to the Depressed Classes
Replaced separate electorates with reserved seats under joint electorates
questions.rationale: Gandhi's Yerawada fast against the Communal Award's separate electorates for the Depressed Classes produced the Poona Pact: joint electorates with reserved seats.

questions.question: The Quit India movement's call 'Do or Die' was given on 8 August 1942 at:
questions.rationale: The All-India Congress Committee's Bombay session passed the Quit India resolution of 8 August 1942; Aruna Asaf Ali hoisted the flag at Gowalia Tank as leaders were arrested.

questions.question: Subhas Chandra Bose proclaimed the Azad Hind Government and the INA's 'Delhi Chalo' slogan in:
questions.rationale: Bose reached Singapore in 1943, proclaimed the Azad Hind Government with the Rani Jhansi Regiment, and led the INA toward Imphal and Kohima in 1944.

questions.question: The Radcliffe Line, drawn for the Partition of 1947, was announced on:
questions.rationale: The Boundary Commission's award was published on 17 August 1947, two days after the midnight transfer of power, cutting through Bengal and the Punjab.
